result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. Excluding the expected horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, one visual defect remains: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, breaking the consistency of the tab bar.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab displays only a text label with no icon above it, while the 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' tabs each have an icon. This leaves a visible empty gap and breaks the visual consistency of the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add an orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag outline) above the 'Orders' label, matching the icon size, stroke weight, and gray inactive color used by the other tabs.
